skill.displayName: Pagrehistro ng PowPow — magrehistro ng Bula, i-pin ang talaarawan ng paglalakbay sa mapa, kausapin ang digital na tao

version.changelog: Localize display name; align search keywords with per-language translations; add categories

llm.summary: This is a guide-only registration helper that stays scoped to explaining PowPow signup, screenshots, errors, and subscription steps without collecting credentials or running code.

dimensions.detail: External URLs are proportionate to the purpose: official PowPow pages, a video link, and public hosted screenshot images. The artifact says not to download images into the skill or use local paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown guidance with an OpenClaw install command only; no scripts, executables, dependencies, post-install actions, or remote code execution are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are prescriptive about using Filipino and showing product screenshots, but they remain scoped to user-facing guidance. The skill explicitly forbids asking for passwords, verification codes, or payment credentials and forbids submitting forms for the user.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, credential store access, or mutation authority is requested. Mentions of cookies and payment flows are explanatory platform behavior, not agent actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is coherent: it helps users understand PowPow Bubble, register on the official site, troubleshoot registration errors, and complete subscription activation. It explicitly says the user performs form entry, verification, and payment in the browser or app.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a Tagalog guide for PowPow registration and subscription activation. Users should still complete signup and payment only on the official PowPow pages and should not share passwords, verification codes, or payment credentials in chat.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The runtime skill and README are in Filipino and the listing declares language "tl", so the language choice is coherent for a Tagalog-localized skill. Mandarin strings in the registration reference are original platform error texts with translations, and the Chinese listing note is a cleanup issue rather than a security concern.
[SQP-1] expected: Screenshot guidance is somewhat broad, but it is limited to 1-3 relevant public product screenshots for explaining the service. It does not create hidden access, local file use, credential handling, or automatic high-impact actions.
